summary: F-012 is closed: the unknown-sender inbound regression now pins the public rejection code CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED on the exit-3 InboundError trust channel instead of accepting any throw, and the changed-device and malformed-ciphertext cases are separate tests that each pin their own typed code. Bounded mutation proves the assertion kills the mutant: with the dedicated missing-contact guard at inbound.ts:50 removed, the strengthened test FAILS with 'expected INBOUND_REJECTED to be CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED', while the previous generic rejects.toThrow() assertion stayed GREEN under the identical mutation. The mutation was reverted and inbound.ts is byte-identical to its pre-mutation state. The harness build race (T33-I1) is removed: dist/cli.js is now built exactly once per vitest run by a new globalSetup, and neither the command suite nor the two-process E2E suite rebuilds it. Anti-flake evidence: three consecutive independent invocations of the CLI suite all passed 10/10 files and 50/50 tests with the two-process E2E green in each. Concern: a parallel worker (T35) added two F-009 test files to apps/cli mid-session that are currently RED because their implementation has not landed, so the unfiltered package suite is not green for reasons outside this task's scope.

acceptance.criterion: F-012 (minor): the unknown-sender fixture test asserts the public rejection code CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED specifically, not a generic rejects.toThrow.
acceptance.evidence: apps/cli/src/runtime/inbound.test.ts: new test 'rejects an envelope from an unpinned sender with CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED before mutation' calls the rejectsWith() helper, which asserts the rejection is an InboundError (exit-3 trust channel, not PersistenceError/exit 5) and that its code is exactly CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED.

acceptance.criterion: The same test still asserts that persisted state is unchanged and that no acknowledgement is sent for the rejected envelope.
acceptance.evidence: The test keeps expect(fake.acks()).toEqual([]) and expect(await snapshot(bob)).toEqual(before) around the strengthened rejection; no pre-existing assertion was weakened or deleted.

acceptance.criterion: The changed-device case and the malformed-ciphertext case remain distinct tests, each asserting its own intended typed failure, so one guard cannot mask another.
acceptance.evidence: The old combined test was split. 'rejects a changed sender device and envelopes addressed to another recipient with their own typed failures' pins CONTACT_PIN_MISMATCH for the changed sender_device_id and INVALID_ENVELOPE for each mis-addressed recipient field. 'rejects malformed native wrappers, tampering and authenticated message-ID mismatch while preserving a valid retry' pins INBOUND_REJECTED per variant and keeps the valid-retry tail assertion.

acceptance.criterion: Bounded mutation evidence: with the dedicated missing-contact guard removed, the inbound suite now FAILS on the CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED assertion (previously it stayed green). The mutation is reverted afterwards and no canonical source file is left modified.
acceptance.evidence: Baseline before the change: 10/10 inbound tests passed. Strengthened suite before mutation: 11/11 passed. Mutation (delete `if (!contactBytes) throw new InboundError("CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED")` at inbound.ts:50): strengthened test FAILED at inbound.test.ts:125 with AssertionError 'expected INBOUND_REJECTED to be CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED'. Control with the same mutation and the ORIGINAL test file: 1/1 passed (the old rejects.toThrow assertion did not kill the mutant). Revert verified by byte diff against the pre-mutation copy: inbound.ts identical, CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED guard present at line 50.

acceptance.criterion: The full CLI test suite and the workspace suite are green with the strengthened test in place.
acceptance.evidence: CLI package: 10/10 files, 50/50 tests green on three consecutive invocations, plus a fully unfiltered green run (10 files / 50 tests) taken before the parallel T35 worker added its files. Workspace packages other than @echolet/cli: protocol, client-db, crypto-core, client-core, session-node and mobile all green. apps/cli typecheck green. NOT green unfiltered right now only because T35 added src/transport/relayClient.pollCapacity.test.ts and src/runtime/inbound.pollBatchSize.test.ts (F-009, 3 tests) at 17:55:56 and 17:56:12 local; those are that worker's not-yet-implemented RED tests and are out of scope here.

acceptance.criterion: Carried from the completed T33 fix (finding T33-I1): remove the test-harness build race.
acceptance.evidence: New apps/cli/vitest.config.ts registers apps/cli/test/globalSetup.ts, which spawns build.mjs once per vitest run before any suite starts. apps/cli/src/commands/cli.test.ts no longer runs `pnpm run build` in beforeAll and instead asserts the binary exists; apps/cli/test/e2e/two-process.test.ts no longer runs `pnpm --filter @echolet/cli build` and instead asserts the binary exists (its Go relay build is unchanged). No CLI behaviour or exit-code mapping was touched.

acceptance.criterion: Anti-flake evidence: after the harness fix, `pnpm --filter @echolet/cli test` passes on three consecutive independent invocations, with the two-process E2E green in each.
acceptance.evidence: Three consecutive independent invocations, each exit 0: run 1 = 10 files / 50 tests passed, two-process E2E 3/3; run 2 = 10 files / 50 tests passed, two-process E2E 3/3; run 3 = 10 files / 50 tests passed, two-process E2E 3/3. The two in-flight T35 F-009 files were excluded from these three runs so the evidence reflects this task's scope; three earlier fully unfiltered invocations were also green before those files existed.

artifacts.summary: Strengthened inbound regression with typed rejection-code assertions and split guard cases.
Registers the single-build globalSetup for the CLI package test run.
Builds dist/cli.js exactly once per vitest run, before any suite spawns it.

changed_files.change: Added a rejectsWith() helper that pins the InboundError type and exact public code; split the combined unknown-sender/changed-device test into two tests; pinned CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED, CONTACT_PIN_MISMATCH, INVALID_ENVELOPE and INBOUND_REJECTED per case. No existing assertion removed or weakened.
New file: vitest config registering test/globalSetup.ts as globalSetup.
New file: builds the CLI bundle once per vitest run via build.mjs and fails the run if the build fails.
beforeAll no longer runs `pnpm run build`; it now asserts the pre-built binary exists. Removed the now-unused scripts.build field from the manifest type.
beforeAll no longer runs `pnpm --filter @echolet/cli build`; it now asserts the pre-built binary exists. Added existsSync to the node:fs import. Go relay build left unchanged.
Temporarily mutated for the kill-the-mutant check and fully reverted; byte-identical to its pre-mutation state.
